title: And it’s over
html:
The Olympics are over and the soul searching, debate over fund allocation and reliving of the 'oh so close' moments have all begun... and that’s just in the media.

The athletes themselves seem to be having a great time but as I looked through the media today I couldn't find any new stories from them. I would like to hear their comments on their performances now that they have had some time to think about it.

Having a microphone shoved in your face when you have just run or paddled your guts out is a daunting prospect and our athletes handled themselves fantastically. They were a credit to New Zealand and it was great to see that we have a new batch of excellent role models.

How would you have handled the pressure, the weight of a country on your shoulders as they live vicariously through you?

I think they did fantastically, so let’s give them a massive welcome when they get back. Have terrific week and show your support for the team around the water-cooler.
